procrustes_fit — SHAPESTAT procrustes op

• Data kinds: points × points → matrix

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.procrustes_fit(source, target, scaling: 'bool' = True, reflection: 'bool' = False) (to call the implementation directly, import shapestats; shapestats.procrustes_fit(source, target, scaling: 'bool' = True, reflection: 'bool' = False); from the registry, opsshapestat.get("procrustes_fit"))

Usage

Similarity transform that superimposes *source* onto *target*. → (4, 4) homogeneous matrix.

It assumes the points are in correspondence (the i-th points are at the same anatomical position). For point sets without correspondence no exception is raised and a meaningless transform is returned -- whether there is correspondence cannot be seen from this function. Without correspondence, use the ICP family (registration).

With scaling=True size differences are also absorbed. reflection=False (default) enforces det(R) = +1 -- if it were allowed, a left-handed individual would overlap a right-handed mean, and left-right asymmetry, the very thing you want to measure, would vanish.

The matrix is in homogeneous coordinates, oriented as target ~ source @ M[:3,:3].T + M[:3,3].
